sentence_stem: Even though the library was closed,
full_sentence: Even though the library was closed, we studied in the park.
acceptable_variants: we still found a place to study.
we studied at a cafe instead.

options.why_wrong: This describes the place but does not give the contrasting action that 'even though' requires.

options.text: because we needed a quiet place.
options.why_wrong: 'Because' shows cause, but 'even though' shows contrast, so this connector does not match.

options.text: we had no books with us.
options.why_wrong: This gives a background fact but not the action that contrasts with the closed library.

explanation: After 'even though', the main clause must show a result that contrasts with the first part of the sentence. Learners often mix up contrast and cause connectors, so check which meaning the connector signals.
translation: Apesar de a biblioteca estar fechada, estudamos no parque.
